<div id="pw-overlay">
  <div class="pw-box">
    <div class="pw-lock">🔒</div>
    <h2>R Scripts — Statistics</h2>
    <p>Enter the password to access this page.</p>
    <div class="pw-row">
      <input type="password" id="pw-input" placeholder="Password" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')checkPw()">
      <button onclick="checkPw()">OK</button>
    </div>
    <p class="pw-err" id="pw-err"></p>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  if(sessionStorage.getItem('rscripts_unlocked')==='1'){
    document.getElementById('pw-overlay').style.display='none';
  }
})();
async function checkPw(){
  var val=document.getElementById('pw-input').value;
  var buf=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(val));
  var hex=Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
  if(hex==='ac95cc34e3ff9d4e59fd3066f6feaee0d2f4f7f97d3865148bc5767834883ff5'){
    sessionStorage.setItem('rscripts_unlocked','1');
    document.getElementById('pw-overlay').style.display='none';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('pw-err').textContent='Incorrect password.';
  }
}
</script>
